description: React component for displaying, searching, filtering, and managing a list of assets in the Assets Management Frontend. It fetches asset data from an API, allows deletion, and supports navigation actions like view, copy, and create.

methods.name: AssetsListPage
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages and displays the assets list, including search, pagination, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an asset, updates the asset list, and shows success/error toasts.
